phases.name: Cash Deposit Receipt and AML Threshold Reporting
phases.description: A customer presents a £12,000 cash deposit at a retail branch counter. Branch staff (PER-056) collect the customer's identity per standard CDD procedures. The cash is counted and verified via the branch's cash handling machine. Since the amount exceeds the £10,000 AML cash reporting threshold (MLR 2017 Regulation 37), an automated AML cash threshold report is generated by SVC-001. The deposit transaction is submitted to Retail Banking Core for posting to the customer's account.
entry_conditions: Customer presents at branch with cash for deposit
Branch staff have verified customer identity per CDD
exit_conditions: Cash deposit transaction created in SVC-001
AML cash threshold report generated and queued for MLRO review

phases.name: Account Credit and Vault Reconciliation
phases.description: The deposit is posted to the customer's current account in Retail Banking Core. The customer receives a receipt. At close of business, the branch manager reconciles the vault cash position against transaction records. Any surplus cash above the maximum float is prepared for repatriation to the bank's cash centre (GardaWorld/Brinks). The daily cash position is reported to Treasury.
entry_conditions: AML report generated for amounts above £10,000
exit_conditions: Vault cash reconciled at close of business
Surplus cash prepared for cash centre repatriation

happy_path.description: Customer presents £12,000 cash → staff verify ID → cash counted → AML threshold report generated → account credited → vault reconciled.

alternative_paths.name: Cash Below AML Threshold — No Report
alternative_paths.description: Customer deposits cash below £10,000 (e.g. £500). No AML threshold report generated. Standard deposit processing only.

exception_paths.name: Cash Count Discrepancy — Branch Incident
exception_paths.description: Cash counting machine identifies a discrepancy between stated and counted amount. Branch manager involved. Discrepancy logged. Cash recounted. If discrepancy persists, Operations team escalated. Deposit held pending resolution.

design_decisions.decision: AML cash threshold report is generated by SVC-001 (Retail Banking Core, CAP-001) and notified to SVC-015 (Compliance Core, CAP-005) via EVT-166. The MLRO review of the report is within CAP-005.
design_decisions.rationale: Deposit transaction is CAP-001's domain. Regulatory reporting and MLRO review is CAP-005's domain. Event-driven cross-capability communication for threshold reports.
design_decisions.alternatives_considered: SVC-015 calling SVC-001 to check every deposit — rejected as polling is inefficient and violates event-driven principles.
